rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF LORNA LIGUID PALANCA
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Hearing. Appearance required. (1) Petition needs to provide information whether the decedent's parents or siblings (now all deceased) had any issues. If yes, they should have been properly noticed. If petitioners do not know of any relatives or heirs, they must file a declaration of diligent search. The court will review these efforts and decide if an heir search company is needed. PARTIES APPEARING SHOULD CHECK IN FOR THE HEARING WITH THEIR FULL NAME. Counsel and parties may appear personally or remotely through Zoom or CourtCall. For a video appearance, go to zoom.us, click "join a meeting" and input meeting ID 160 225 4765 and password 514879. For an audio-only appearance through Zoom, call 1-669-254-5252 and key in meeting ID "160 225 4765#", then participant ID "0#", then password "514879#". (Toll rates may apply).) The Court prefers that counsel and parties appearing by video input their first and last name into the "Your Name" dialogue box. Counsel and parties may appear by audio-only telephone through CourtCall by calling 1-888-882-6878. Please review LRSF 14.1(C) for more information.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF JOSEPH ALEN BANKS JR
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Hearing. Appearance required. (1) The following issues with the Petition must be resolved. Please submit either an amended petition or a verified supplement addressing all items listed below. (a) Page 2 is incomplete and missing sections #h.(3)-(4). (b) The caption does not specify the full IAEA authority requested, although section #2.c. seeks full IAEA authority. (c) #8 must include the decedent's mother's name, relationship, and contact information. If her whereabouts are unknown, file a declaration of due diligent search detailing efforts to locate her. If she predeceased the decedent, provide her date of death. (d) #2.d. does not address bond. If the decedent's mother is living or her status is unknown, the Court is unlikely to waive bond without her Waiver of Bond. (e) #3.d. estimates the estate value as zero. The Court may inquire into the necessity of this proceeding. (2) Unless the decedent's mother has predeceased, mail the Notice of Petition to Administer Estate [DE-121] to her. Also provide the Notice of Direction for Remote Appearances and Access (LRSF 14.1.C.6). (3) Duties and Liabilities of Personal Representative (DE-147) must be filed. (4) Confidential Statement (DE-147S) must be filed. See LR 14.48.E and 14.59.C. (5) Proposed order must be submitted. LR 14.7.A.1. PARTIES APPEARING SHOULD CHECK IN FOR THE HEARING WITH THEIR FULL NAME. Counsel and parties may appear personally or remotely through Zoom or CourtCall. For a video appearance, go to zoom.us, click "join a meeting" and input meeting ID 160 225 4765 and password 514879. For an audio-only appearance through Zoom, call 1-669-254-5252 and key in meeting ID "160 225 4765#", then participant ID "0#", then password "514879#". (Toll rates may apply).) The Court prefers that counsel and parties appearing by video input their first and last name into the "Your Name" dialogue box. Counsel and parties may appear by audio-only telephone through CourtCall by calling 1-888-882-6878. Please review LRSF 14.1(C) for more information.
